correctness.rationale: Reconstruction starts from the exact three-coordinate polynomial and the closed simplex. Independent symbolic expansion proves the p,q update, D(Vx), D(V²x) identities and the radical optimizer. The q-derivative is nonpositive everywhere on the feasible (p,q) region by Schur and elementary factorization; the two extremal q-branches reduce the global ratio to two rigorously optimized one-variable functions. Equality requires the two-large-equal configuration at the unique derivative root. The one-step bound follows by the same branch reduction and closes the arbitrary-n inequality. The standalone sympy checker executed successfully; 367 exact rational states are corroborative only. The paper’s qualitative stability premises are not assumed in the proof.

originality.rationale: The exact best two-generation variance contraction coefficient, unique interior equality composition, and one-step-versus-two-step contrast are not implied by the source paper’s qualitative global convergence and product-of-gaps Lyapunov argument. The computed extremum is neither a local Jacobian spectral factor nor a routine restatement: the global optimizer is nonuniform and strictly interior. Direct comparisons of the source theorem and methods, relevant permutation-QSO primary literature, and a separate nonlinear-stochastic regularity paper found no statement of this coefficient. published-finding corpus searches and accessible own prior research claims likewise found no dominating result. Unindexed general variance-contraction work remains a publication-priority risk.

value.rationale: Determining the genuinely optimal short-horizon mixing coefficient is a natural quantitative refinement of a globally regular heredity map. The surprising feature is that one generation is only nonexpansive, with exact neutral edge-midpoint states, but two generations uniformly contract at a small algebraic factor achieved at a different, strictly interior population mixture. This distinguishes transient worst-case mixing from the local linearized rate and supplies a sharp global error guarantee for every initial population. It is not a routine restatement of convergence or a parameter substitution.
